comment: Inline panel type catalog for The Риэлтор. Utility-first: each panel teaches a fact from its H2. No host face on inline.
utility_test: Reader who has NOT read the paragraph must still extract a concrete fact, order, number, or comparison from the image alone. If labels removed → nothing understandable = FAIL. Row of 5 gold icon circles with 3-word captions = FAIL.
style_lock: Same as approved cover B02: #FFFFFF high-key, gold #dcc5a1 / black #141821, torn paper, gold tape, pins, thin strings, sun flare, collage. Small meme sticker on 2–3 of 7 inlines only (≤15% frame; catalog people-memes or cats — never a second human hero).
forbidden_inline: stock model / handsome realtor / generated man as co-host or presenter
large human (any non-host) on inline — hero slot, left portrait, talking-head, pointing at table
meme person >15% of frame or occupying presenter slot
invented photogenic stranger called a meme — use memory/cover/meme-top100.json only
row of decorative icons + 3-word mood captions
«не эскроу» as process step 4 instead of footnote

comparison_table.utility: Real columns/rows; numbers when Writer gave them; left vs right must differ

process_flow.utility: Numbered steps; one failure/success point highlighted; evidence as callout not extra step

bar_timeline_chart.utility: Comparable bar or timeline with durations, rates, amounts — visually scannable

structure_diagram.utility: Who holds money, when release; arrows + blocks; footnotes aside

labeled_checklist.utility: Named errors vs correct path rows — not generic «типичные ошибки»

fact_card.utility: Only if 3–6 DISTINCT facts (not synonyms); last resort
